work.title: Work
work.allPurpose: Every project at once. Each tab here shows the same thing as inside a component, with a Component column.

help.title: Work
help.body: Work is everything you do inside your projects, in one place. Pick a project or a sub component on the left. Its page has tabs: what is running, the loops, the plan, what Aeon knows about the code, what runs by itself, the checks that guard it, its files and its history. Pick **All projects** to see the same tabs across everything.

overview.recentEmpty: No loops here yet. Start one to see it appear.

moved.title: This part is still on its own page
moved.body: It is moving into the component. Until then it lives here:

unknown.title: That component is not here
unknown.body: It may have been removed. Pick one from the list.

work.error: The component list did not answer: {error}

files.needsOne: Pick one component to browse its files.

knowledge.shared: {names} share the index of the repository they live in.

guardrails.needsOne: Gates, environments and triage belong to one component. Pick one in the menu.

tasks.hint: Real tasks from the daemon. A card moves when an agent finishes a step — the board follows the daemon, you do not drag.

timeline.hint: Each bar runs from when the item first started running to when it finished (or to now). An item that has not started yet sits on the day it was created.
timeline.needsOne: A roadmap belongs to one component. Pick one in the menu.
timeline.empty: This roadmap has no items yet.

goals.hint: Click a goal to read its documents and decide.

automation.continuous: Continuous work — loops the daemon starts on its own
